# LOPDIA Isofrac Integration

- requires IsoFrac_LOPIT.rda 

## INitializations

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(parallel)
dirpath <- dirname(rstudioapi::documentPath())
setwd(dirpath )
dir.create("ClusterResults")
runDistance <- F
load("./IsoFrac_LOPIT_20260408.rda")

IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean <- IsoFrac_LOPIT[!is.na(PC1)]
length(unique(IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean$hgnc_symbol))
IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean[,IsoFrac_Group:=paste(unique(round(IsoFrac_MW)),collapse=";"),Seq]

IsoFrac_LOPIT[hgnc_symbol=="CTSB"]$IsoFrac_Group_n
```

## Distance Calculations

```{r}
runDistance <- F
if(runDistance){
  library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(parallel)
setwd(dirpath <- "E:/MaxQuant/HZ/20220114_Isofrac_v2/REBUTTAL_Temp/")

Distance_Function <- function(tempBackup,Scale_PCs=F,Randomize=F,PCgrepString="^PC[1-9]$"){
  Distances <- NULL
  try({
    temp <- tempBackup
    temp <- temp[!is.na(PC1)]
    if(Randomize){
      temp$IsoFrac_Group <- sample(temp$IsoFrac_Group)
    }
    
    temp <- as.data.table(temp)
    if(length(temp$IsoFrac_Group)==0){
      stop("Please assign Isofrac groups.")
    }
    centroid <- function(X) colMeans(X, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    PCs <- temp[,.SD,.SDcols=grep(PCgrepString,names(temp)),by=.(IsoFrac_Group)]
    
    if(Scale_PCs){
      IsfGr <- PCs$IsoFrac_Group
      PCs$IsoFrac_Group <- NULL
      PCs <- apply(PCs,2,scale)
      PCs <- data.table(PCs)
      PCs$IsoFrac_Group <- IsfGr
    }
    
    # calculating all centroids
    AllCentroids= PCs[,{
      
      PCstemp <- .SD[,.SD,.SDcols=grep(PCgrepString,names(.SD))]    
      as.data.table(t(data.frame(centroid(PCstemp))))
      
    },.(IsoFrac_Group)]
    
    
    Distances <- temp[,
                      {
                        ToOther_Distance <- NULL
                        ({
                          ThisCentroidName <- .BY$IsoFrac_Group
                          gr <- .BY
                          # Extract PC Matrix
                          # Find current Centroid
                          ThisCentroid <- AllCentroids[IsoFrac_Group==gr$IsoFrac_Group]
                          ThisCentroid$IsoFrac_Group <- NULL
                          # and other Centroids
                          
                          OtherCentroids <- AllCentroids[IsoFrac_Group!=gr$IsoFrac_Group]
                          OtherCentroidsNames <- OtherCentroids$IsoFrac_Group
                          OtherCentroids$IsoFrac_Group <- NULL
                          
                          # PCs
                          PCs_selected <- PCs[gr$IsoFrac_Group==IsoFrac_Group]
                          Peptides <- temp[gr$IsoFrac_Group==IsoFrac_Group]$Seq
                          
                          PCs_selected$IsoFrac_Group <- NULL
                         
                          # Distance Calculations per Sequence
                          ToOther_Distance <- lapply(1:dim(PCs_selected)[1],function(it){
                            xpeptide <- PCs_selected[it,]
                            OtherCentroids_distances <- lapply(1:dim(OtherCentroids)[1],function(yit){
                              y <- OtherCentroids[yit,]
                              obs_dist <- sqrt(sum((xpeptide - y)^2))
                              Centroid_Distance <- sqrt(sum((ThisCentroid - y)^2))
                              data.table(obs_dist_toOther=obs_dist,Centroid_Distance=Centroid_Distance,ThisCentroidName=ThisCentroidName,ComparisonCentroidName=OtherCentroidsNames[yit])
                            })
                            OtherCentroids_distances <- rbindlist(OtherCentroids_distances)
                            
                            OtherCentroids_distances$obs_dist_within = sqrt(sum((xpeptide - ThisCentroid)^2))
                            OtherCentroids_distances$Peptide = Peptides[it]
                            OtherCentroids_distances
                          })
                          ToOther_Distance <- rbindlist(ToOther_Distance)
                          
                        })
                        ToOther_Distance
                      },
                      .(IsoFrac_Group,IsoFrac_MW)]
    
   
    
    
    if(1){
      PCs <- PCs[,.SD,.SDcols = grep("^PC[123]$",names(PCs)),by=IsoFrac_Group]
      library(MASS)
      library(mvtnorm)
      gr <- as.list(unique(temp$IsoFrac_Group))
      names(gr) <- "IsoFrac_Group"
      Overlap <- temp[,
                      {
                        ToOther_Distance <- NULL
                        try({
                          gr <- .BY
                          ThisCentroidName <- .BY$IsoFrac_Group
                          
                          ThesePCs <- PCs[IsoFrac_Group==gr$IsoFrac_Group]
                          OtherPCs <- PCs[IsoFrac_Group!=gr$IsoFrac_Group]
                          
                          # Extract PC Matrix
                          
                          Overlap_List <- lapply(1:length(unique(OtherPCs$IsoFrac_Group)),function(yit){
                            PCcols <- grep("^PC", names(PCs), value = TRUE)
                            
                            A <- (OtherPCs[IsoFrac_Group == unique(OtherPCs$IsoFrac_Group)[yit],])
                            A$IsoFrac_Group <- NULL
                            B <- ThesePCs#(PCs[IsoFrac_Group == gr$IsoFrac_Group, ])
                            B$IsoFrac_Group <- NULL
                            muA <- colMeans(A)
                            muB <- colMeans(B)
                            
                            SA <- cov(A)
                            SB <- cov(B)
                            
                            # sample points
                            n <- 10000
                            XA <- mvrnorm(n, muA, SA)
                            XB <- mvrnorm(n, muB, SB)
                            
                            # density evaluation
                            dA <- dmvnorm(XA, muA, SA,log=T)
                            dB <- dmvnorm(XA, muB, SB,log=T)
                            
                            overlap <- mean(exp(pmin(dA, dB) - dA))
                            
                            
                            list(This_Centroid=gr$IsoFrac_Group,Other_Centroid=unique(OtherPCs$IsoFrac_Group)[yit],Overlap=overlap)
                            
                          })
                          ToOther_Distance <- rbindlist(Overlap_List)
                          
                        })
                        # print(ToOther_Distance)
                        ToOther_Distance
                      },
                      .(IsoFrac_Group,IsoFrac_MW)]
      Overlap <- Overlap[!is.na(Overlap)]
      library(MASS)
      Distances[,GroupOverlap:={
        gr <- .BY
        # prnt(gr)
        # print(class(mahalanobisDistance))
        
        o1= Overlap[gr$ThisCentroidName==This_Centroid&
                      Other_Centroid==gr$ComparisonCentroidName]$Overlap
        o2= Overlap[gr$ThisCentroidName==This_Centroid&
                      Other_Centroid==gr$ComparisonCentroidName]$Overlap
        hu <- c(o1,o2)
        hu <- hu[!is.na(hu)]
        unique(hu)[1]
        
      },.(ThisCentroidName,ComparisonCentroidName)]
      
      
      
      
      
    }
    
    
    
    Distances <- unique(Distances)
    Distances[,c("Average_within","Average_toOther"):={
      list(mean(obs_dist_within,na.rm=T),
           mean(obs_dist_toOther)
      )
      
    },.(IsoFrac_MW,ComparisonCentroidName)]
    Distances$hgnc_symbol <- temp$hgnc_symbol[1]
    Distances$ENS <- temp$ENS[1]
    
    Distances$marker <- temp$Marker[1]
    
    Distances[,Wilcoxon_p:={
      temp <- .SD
      pout <- 1
      try({
        pout <- wilcox.test(log2(temp$obs_dist_toOther/temp$obs_dist_within),mu = 0,alternative = "greater")$p.value
        
      })
      pout
    },.(hgnc_symbol,IsoFrac_Group)]
   
    Distances$Mode <- paste(c("Randomize","Scale_PCs")[c(Randomize,Scale_PCs)],collapse="#")
    
  })    
  Distances
}


cl <- makeCluster(20)
clusterExport(cl,c("Distance_Function","dirpath"))
IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean_split <- split(IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean,IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean$hgnc_symbol)
# input
li <- list.files(  paste(dirpath,"ClusterResults",sep="/"))
missing <- which(is.na(match(names(IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean_split),basename(li))))

IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean_split_subset <- IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean_split[missing]
DistanceResults_list <- parLapply(cl,IsoFrac_LOPIT_clean_split_subset,function(input){
  library(data.table)
  outpath <- paste(dirpath,"ClusterResults",input$hgnc_symbol[1],sep="/")
  if(!file.exists(outpath)){
    DistanceCollect <- lapply(1:11,function(i){
      cat("\r",i)
      if(i==1){
        Distance <- Distance_Function(input,F,F)
      }else{
        Distance <- Distance_Function(input,F,T)
        
      }
      Distance$Iteration <- i
      Distance
      
    })
    DistanceCollect_dt <- rbindlist(DistanceCollect)
    
    save(DistanceCollect_dt,file=outpath)
  }
  
  
  NULL
})
stopCluster(cl)

DistanceResults_dt <- rbindlist(DistanceResults_list,fill=T)
 
}
```

##  Combing Results

```{r}
  li <- list.files("../REBUTTAL_Temp/ClusterResults/",full.names = T,recursive = T)
  wd <- getwd()
  library(parallel)
  cl2 <- makeCluster(20)
  clusterExport(cl2,"wd")
  DistanceResults_list <- parLapply(cl2,li,function(x){
    setwd(wd)
    library(data.table)
    cat("\r",x)
    load(x)
    if(length(DistanceCollect_dt$hgnc_symbol)==0){
      DistanceCollect_dt$hgnc_symbol <- basename(x)
    }
    DistanceCollect_dt[,Wilcoxon_p:={
      temp <- .SD
      pout <- 1
      try({
        pout <- wilcox.test(log2(temp$obs_dist_toOther/temp$obs_dist_within),mu = 0,alternative = "greater")$p.value
        
      })
      pout
    },.(hgnc_symbol,IsoFrac_Group,Iteration)]
    DistanceCollect_dt
  })
  stopCluster(cl2)
  names(DistanceResults_list) <- basename(li)
  
  # Adding DeltaMass Information
  DistanceResults_DT <- rbindlist(DistanceResults_list,fill=T)
  DistanceResults_DT[,DeltaMass_Category_Fac:=paste(unique(IsoFrac_LOPIT[Seq==.BY$Peptide]$DeltaMass_Category_Fac),collapse=";"),Peptide]
  save("DistanceResults_DT",file="DistanceResults_DT.rda")
  
```
## Compressing to protein level

```{r}


  DistanceResults_DT <- DistanceResults_DT[!grepl(";",hgnc_symbol)]
  DistanceResults_DT$Wilcoxon_p_BH <- p.adjust(DistanceResults_DT$Wilcoxon_p,"BH")
  DistanceResults_DT[,IsoFrac_Group:=paste(unique(round(IsoFrac_MW)),collapse=";"),Peptide]
  DistanceResults_DT[,IsoFrac_Group_n:=length(unique(IsoFrac_Group)),hgnc_symbol]
  
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins <- DistanceResults_DT[,{
    temp <- .SD
    #stop()
    av <- log2(temp$obs_dist_toOther/temp$obs_dist_within)
    temp <- .SD[av==median(av,na.rm=T)]
    
    .(Wilcoxon_p_mn=median(temp$Wilcoxon_p_BH,na.rm=T),
      nPeps=length(unique(.SD$Peptide)),
      Distance=median(av,na.rm=T))
  },.(IsoFrac_MW,hgnc_symbol,DeltaMass_Category_Fac,Mode,Iteration,IsoFrac_Group)]
  
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins$Significant <- "not significant"
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins[Wilcoxon_p_mn<0.01&nPeps>1]$Significant <- "adj.p < 0.01"
  table(IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins$DeltaMass_Category_Fac)
  

  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins$Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac <- NULL
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins$Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac <- "Other"
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins[DeltaMass_Category_Fac=="Processing"]$Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac <- "UniProt Shorter Variants"
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins[DeltaMass_Category_Fac=="Putative_Processing"]$Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac <- "Shorter variant candidates"
  table(IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins$Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac)
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts <- IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins[!is.na(Mode),.(Genes=length(unique(hgnc_symbol)),Isoforms=length(unique(paste(hgnc_symbol,IsoFrac_Group)))),.(Significant,Iteration,Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac,Mode)]
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts_melt <- melt(IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts,measure.vars = c("Genes","Isoforms"))
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts_melt$Distance <- 2
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts_melt[Mode=="Randomize"&Significant=="not significant"&Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac=="Other"]
  IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts_melt <- IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts_melt[,.(value=median(value)),.(variable,Distance,Mode,Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac,Significant)]
    IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts_melt_v2 <- IsoFrac_Lopit_Results_dt_proteins_counts_melt[,.(value=median(value)),.(variable,Distance,Mode,Condensed_DeltaMass_Category_Fac)]
```

## Functions
```{r}
  PC_Hull_Plot <- function(PCsubset){
    PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group <- as.character(PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group)
    p <- ggplot()
    try({
      p <- ggplot(PCsubset, aes(x = jitter(PC1), y = PC2, color = IsoFrac_Group,size=DeltaMass_Category_Fac)) +
        geom_point(alpha=0.2) +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = "2D Scatter Plot of Groups with Between-Group Distances")
      hulls <- PCsubset[!is.na(PC1), .SD[chull(PC1, PC2)], by = IsoFrac_Group]
      p <- p+geom_polygon(data = hulls,
                          alpha = 0.2,color="transparent",aes(fill=IsoFrac_Group))
    })
    p#+theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  library(cowplot)
  PC_Centroid_Plot <- function(PCsubset){
    G <- PCsubset$hgnc_symbol[1]
    
    PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group <- as.character(PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group)
    PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group_num <- as.numeric(PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group)
    
    PCsubsetCentroid <- PCsubset[,.(PC1=mean(PC1),PC2=mean(PC2),PC1sd=sd(PC1),PC2sd=sd(PC2)),.(IsoFrac_Group,IsoFrac_Group_num,DeltaMass_Category_Fac)]
    
    # ensure the exact row order you want
    setorder(PCsubsetCentroid, IsoFrac_Group_num)
    PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- NULL
    PCA_Peptide <- NULL
    try({
      PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- ggplot(PCsubset, aes(x = jitter(PC1), y = PC2, color = IsoFrac_Group))+geom_point()+geom_path(data=PCsubsetCentroid,aes(PC1,PC2,group=1))+
        geom_point(data=PCsubsetCentroid,aes(size=IsoFrac_Group_num))
      
    })
    
    library(ggplot2)
    try({
      PCA_centroid <- ggplot(PCsubsetCentroid, aes(PC1, PC2,color=IsoFrac_Group, group = 1,pch=DeltaMass_Category_Fac)) +   # group=1 = single line
        geom_path(color="grey",lwd=3) +                                        # respects row order
        geom_point(aes(size=IsoFrac_Group_num),show.legend = F) +
        geom_text(aes(label = IsoFrac_Group),show.legend = F, vjust = -0.5)+ggtitle(G)
      
    })
    try({
      PCA_hull <- ggplot(PCsubsetCentroid, aes(x = jitter(PC1), y = PC2, color = IsoFrac_Group,size=IsoFrac_Group)) +
        geom_point(alpha=0.2) +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = "2D Scatter Plot of Groups with Between-Group Distances")
      hulls <- PCsubset[!is.na(PC1), .SD[chull(PC1, PC2)], by = IsoFrac_Group]
      PCA_hull <- p+geom_polygon(data = hulls,
                                 alpha = 0.2,color="transparent",aes(fill=IsoFrac_Group))
    })
    PCA_markers <- NULL
    try({
      
      
      MarkerHulls$IsoFrac_Group <- ""
      MarkerHulls$DeltaMass_Category_Fac <- ""
      PCA_markers <- ggplot(PCsubsetCentroid, aes(PC1, PC2,color=IsoFrac_Group, group = 1,pch=DeltaMass_Category_Fac))
      it <- 0
      rbcolors <- rainbow(length(unique(MarkerHulls$Marker)),v=0.8)
      for(i in split(MarkerHulls,MarkerHulls$Marker)){
        it <- it+1
        PCA_markers <- PCA_markers+annotate("polygon", x = i$PC1, y = i$PC2, fill =rbcolors[it], colour = rbcolors[it],alpha=0.2)
        PCA_markers <- PCA_markers+annotate("label",x= mean(i$PC1), y=mean(i$PC2),label=i$Marker[1])
        
      }
      
      yr <- range(PCsubsetCentroid$PC2)
      xr <- range(PCsubsetCentroid$PC1)
      
      outzoom <- 0.5
      
      PCA_markers <- PCA_markers+
        geom_path(color="grey",lwd=3) +                                        # respects row order
        geom_point(aes(size=IsoFrac_Group_num),show.legend = F) +
        geom_text(aes(label = IsoFrac_Group),show.legend = F, vjust = -0.5)+ggtitle(G)
      PCA_markers_zoom <- PCA_markers+coord_cartesian(ylim=yr+diff(yr)*c(-outzoom,outzoom),xlim=xr+diff(xr)*c(-outzoom,outzoom))
    })
    
    list(PCA_hull=PCA_hull,PCA_centroid=PCA_centroid,PCA_Peptide_Centroid=PCA_Peptide_Centroid,PCA_markers=PCA_markers,PCA_markers_zoom=PCA_markers_zoom)
  }
```

# Marker LOPIT Peptides


```{r}
q <- 0.05
  IsoFrac_LOPIT_x <- lapply(split(IsoFrac_LOPIT,IsoFrac_LOPIT$markers),function(x){
    x[!is.na(PC1)][ PC1 >= quantile(PC1, q) &
                      PC1 <= quantile(PC1, 1 - q) &
                      PC2 >= quantile(PC2, q) &
                      
                      PC2 <= quantile(PC2, 1 - q)]
  })
  IsoFrac_LOPITsubset <- rbindlist(IsoFrac_LOPIT_x)
  names(IsoFrac_LOPIT) <- make.unique(names(IsoFrac_LOPIT))
  MarkerHulls <- IsoFrac_LOPITsubset[!is.na(PC1)&markers!="unknown", .SD[chull(PC1, PC2)], by = Marker]
  names(MarkerHulls) <- make.unique(names(MarkerHulls))
  names(MarkerHulls) <- make.unique(names(MarkerHulls))
```

## Example Protein

```{r}
LOPITmap_ggOverlay <- function(PCsubset,MarkerHulls=NULL,AddCentroids=T,AddDistanceLines=T){
      G <- PCsubset$hgnc_symbol[1]
  try({
    
    PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- ggplot(PCsubset, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, fill = as.character(IsoFrac_Group)))
    PCsubsetCentroid <- PCsubset[,.(PC1=mean(PC1),PC2=mean(PC2),PC1sd=sd(PC1),PC2sd=sd(PC2)),.(IsoFrac_Group,IsoFrac_Group_num,DeltaMass_Category_Fac)]

    
        if(AddDistanceLines){
      try({
        PCsubsetPaths <- PCsubset[,{
          gr <- .BY
          within <- PCsubsetCentroid[IsoFrac_Group==gr$IsoFrac_Group]
          toother <- PCsubsetCentroid[IsoFrac_Group!=gr$IsoFrac_Group]
          
          temp <- .SD
          temp$BestCluster  <- NULL
          temp$score_ref <- NULL
          temp <- unique(temp)
          temp <- temp[score_ref==max(score_ref)][1,]
          list(PC1=c(temp$PC1,within$PC1,temp$PC1,toother$PC1),
               PC2=c(temp$PC2,within$PC2,temp$PC2,toother$PC2),
               group=c(rep("within",dim(within)[1]+1),rep("to other",dim(toother)[1]+1))
               )
        },.(Sequence,IsoFrac_Group)]
        PCsubsetPaths_split <- split(PCsubsetPaths,paste(PCsubsetPaths$Sequence))
        for(i in PCsubsetPaths_split){
          
          PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- PCA_Peptide_Centroid+ geom_path(data=i,aes(PC1,PC2,color=group),lwd=1)
          
        }
        
      })
    }

    
    # Add Markers
    if(length(MarkerHulls)>0){
      rbcolors <- rainbow(length(unique(MarkerHulls$Marker)),v=0.8)
      it <- 0
      for(i in split(MarkerHulls,MarkerHulls$Marker)){
        it <- it+1
        
        PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- PCA_Peptide_Centroid+annotate("polygon", x = i$PC1, y = i$PC2, fill =rbcolors[it], colour = rbcolors[it],alpha=0.1)
        #PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- PCA_Peptide_Centroid+annotate("label",x= mean(i$PC1), y=mean(i$PC2),label=i$Marker[1],color=rbcolors[it])
        
      }
      it <- 0
      for(i in split(MarkerHulls,MarkerHulls$Marker)){
        it <- it+1
        
        
        #PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- PCA_Peptide_Centroid+annotate("polygon", x = i$PC1, y = i$PC2, fill =rbcolors[it], colour = rbcolors[it],alpha=0.1)
        if(i$Marker[1]=="Lysosome"){
           PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- PCA_Peptide_Centroid+annotate("label",x= mean(i$PC1), y=mean(i$PC2),label=i$Marker[1],color=rbcolors[it],hjust=1.3)
        }else{
           PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- PCA_Peptide_Centroid+annotate("label",x= mean(i$PC1), y=mean(i$PC2),label=i$Marker[1],color=rbcolors[it])
        }
       
        
      }
    }

    
    # Adding Centroids
    if(AddCentroids){
      PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- 
        PCA_Peptide_Centroid+geom_point(pch=21,cex=5)+
        geom_point(data=PCsubsetCentroid,pch=23,cex=10)
    }
   
    # add Centroid Path:
    #PCA_Peptide_Centroid <- PCA_Peptide_Centroid+geom_path(data=PCsubsetCentroid,aes(PC1,PC2,group=1))
    # Add Within and to other centroids:
    
    # Adding Distance Lines
    
    
    PCA_Peptide_Centroid+theme(legend.title=element_blank())+ggtitle(G)+coord_cartesian(xlim=c(2,8),ylim=c(-2,5))
  })
  
}

IsoFrac_LOPIT$IsoFrac_MW <- IsoFrac_LOPIT$IsoFrac_MW.1
grep("ENSG00000164733",IsoFrac_LOPIT$ENSG)

PCsubset <- IsoFrac_LOPIT[hgnc_symbol=="CTSB"&!is.na(PC1)]

names(PCsubset) <- make.unique(names(PCsubset))

PCsubset[,IsoFrac_Group:=paste(sort(unique(IsoFrac_MW)),collapse=";"),Seq]
PCsubset <- PCsubset[!is.na(IsoFrac_Group)]

#PCsubset[,IsoFrac_Group:=IsoFrac_MW,Seq]

#PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group <- as.character(PCsubset$IsoFrac_Group)
PCsubset[,IsoFrac_Group_num:=median(unlist(strsplit(as.character(.BY$IsoFrac_Group),"_")),na.rm=T),IsoFrac_Group]
PCsubset <- PCsubset[!is.na(PC1)]

gg_CTSB_LOPIT <- LOPITmap_ggOverlay(PCsubset,MarkerHulls = MarkerHulls ,AddCentroids = T,AddDistanceLines = T)

gg_CTSB_LOPIT$layers[[30]]$aes_params$size <- 4
gg_CTSB_LOPIT$layers[[31]]$aes_params$size <- 4

gg_CTSB_LOPIT
```
